create_Fuzzer_benchmark: create a Fuzzer with FuzzedParameter and FuzzedTensor configurations to generate random tensor benchmarks
run_FuzzedParameter_loguniform: run a FuzzedParameter with loguniform distribution generating values between minval and maxval
run_FuzzedTensor_contiguous: run a FuzzedTensor with probability_contiguous and dim_parameter to generate random tensor layouts
test_Fuzzer_take: test the Fuzzer.take method to generate n valid tensor configurations from fuzzed parameters
run_Timer_benchmark: run a Timer with a statement and globals to benchmark Python expressions with auto-ranged iterations
